name: First Titanomachy
outcome: Olympian victory; Kronos sliced into pieces with his own scythe and cast into Tartarus alongside the elder Titans.
significance: Established Olympian rule over the universe, ending the Golden Age of Kronos and ushering in the reign of the Twelve Olympians.
description: Ten-year cosmic war fought between the elder Titans led by Kronos and the young Olympian gods led by Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades.

name: Battle of the St. Louis Arch
outcome: Percy jumps from the observation deck of the Gateway Arch into the Mississippi River to survive Chimera's venomous fire.
significance: First public monster confrontation for Percy; Poseidon proves his active protection by rescuing Percy in the river and sending a nereid message.
description: Perilous battle atop the St. Louis Arch where Echidna and the Chimera corner Percy Jackson.

name: Duel at Santa Monica Beach
outcome: Percy wounds Ares's heel using a wave-boosted strike with Riptide; Ares surrenders the Helm of Darkness and Master Bolt.
significance: First modern duel between a demigod and an Olympian god; exposes Kronos's telepathic manipulation of Ares and Luke Castellan.
description: Single-combat duel on the beach between twelve-year-old Percy Jackson and Ares, the God of War.

name: Battle of Monster Donut
outcome: Clarisse orders full cannon broadsides from the CSS Birmingham steamship, obliterating the Lernean Hydra.
significance: Saved Percy, Annabeth, and Tyson from the Hydra at a deserted Monster Donut shop; united Clarisse's crew with Percy's group.
description: Battle in Virginia where Clarisse's ironclad steamship rescues Percy, Annabeth, and Tyson from a multiplying Hydra.

name: Clash at C.C.'s Spa and Resort
outcome: Annabeth uses Hermes's multivitamins to turn Percy back into a human, frees blackbeard's pirate crew, and escapes on the Queen Anne's Revenge.
significance: Rescued Percy from Circe's guinea pig potion and secured the pirate ship needed to reach Polyphemus's island.
description: Infiltration and escape from Circe's enchanted island spa resort.

name: Battle of Polyphemus's Island
outcome: Percy overpowers Polyphemus; Tyson knocks Polyphemus into the sea; heroes recover the Golden Fleece and escape.
significance: Successfully retrieved the Golden Fleece to heal Thalia's pine tree and rescued Grover Underwood from Polyphemus's cave.
description: Climactic battle on the island of the Cyclops Polyphemus in the Sea of Monsters.

name: Resurrection of Thalia Grace
outcome: The Golden Fleece purges poison from Thalia's pine tree so thoroughly that Thalia Grace is expelled from the tree in human form.
significance: Introduced a second living Big Three demigod child, drastically altering the stakes and timeline of the Great Prophecy.
description: The magic of the Golden Fleece restores Thalia Grace to physical life on Half-Blood Hill.

name: Skirmish at Westover Hall
outcome: Dr. Thorn kidnaps Annabeth over the cliff into the sea; Hunters of Artemis arrive and force Dr. Thorn to retreat.
significance: Annabeth captured; Artemis sets out alone to track the monster and is captured, initiating the Quest for Artemis.
description: Winter battle at a Maine military school where the manticore Dr. Thorn attacks the heroes while trying to kidnap Bianca and Nico di Angelo.

name: Battle at the Air and Space Museum
outcome: Percy feeds freeze-dried astronaut ice cream into the Nemean Lion's mouth, allowing Zoë to shoot silver arrows down its throat; Percy takes the lion pelt.
significance: First major victory on the Quest for Artemis; Percy acquires the impervious Nemean Lion coat.
description: Skirmish inside the National Air and Space Museum in Washington D.C. against the Nemean Lion and skeleton warriors.

name: Destruction of the Talos Automaton
outcome: Bianca climbs inside the foot maintenance hatch of the giant automaton to sabotage it, destroying it but dying in the collapse.
significance: Fulfills the prophecy line 'One shall be lost in the land without rain'; tragic death of Bianca di Angelo in the Junkyard of the Gods.
description: Sacrifice in the Junkyard of the Gods in New Mexico where Bianca di Angelo gives her life to destroy a rogue prototype Talos metal giant.

name: Battle of Mount Tamalpais
outcome: Percy temporarily holds the sky so Artemis can fight Atlas; Atlas trapped back beneath the sky; Thalia kicks Luke off cliff; Zoë dies of poison and becomes a constellation.
significance: Rescued Artemis and Annabeth; Thalia joins Hunters of Artemis (aging out of Great Prophecy); Zoë Nightshade dies honorably.
description: Climactic battle at the Garden of the Hesperides on Mount Tamalpais against Atlas and Luke's forces.

name: Battle of the Goode High School Gymnasium
outcome: Annabeth stabs empousa Kelli; gym burns down in flames; Percy flees with Rachel Elizabeth Dare before returning to Camp Half-Blood.
significance: Forces Percy to leave mortal school and head to Camp Half-Blood; introduces Rachel Elizabeth Dare to Annabeth and the demigod world.
description: Orientation attack at Goode High School by empousai disguised as cheerleaders.

name: Skirmish at Geryon's Triple G Ranch
outcome: Percy shoots an arrow guided by the West Wind that pierces all three of Geryon's hearts; cleans the Stables of Orthrus using river nymph waters.
significance: Frees Nico di Angelo from Geryon's control and restores Nico's trust in Percy Jackson.
description: Battle at a monster cattle ranch in Texas against three-bodied giant Geryon.

name: Eruption of Mount St. Helens
outcome: Percy causes a massive volcanic water explosion inside the smithy forge, blasting himself to Ogygia and triggering Mount St. Helens eruption.
significance: Awakened Typhon beneath the volcano; Percy marooned on Ogygia with Calypso; Annabeth believes Percy is dead.
description: Explosive battle inside the subterranean forging complex of the Telekhines at Mount St. Helens.

name: Battle of the Labyrinth
outcome: Briares crushes Kampê with rock barrage; Daedalus surrenders his soul to Thanatos to permanently collapse the Labyrinth.
significance: Saved Camp Half-Blood from subterranean invasion; destroyed Daedalus's Labyrinth permanent structure.
description: Massive battle in Camp Half-Blood's clearing when Kronos's invasion force exits the Labyrinth workshops.

name: Beckendorf's Sacrifice
outcome: Princess Andromeda destroyed with Greek fire explosion.
significance: Delayed Kronos's invasion fleet but cost the life of Hephaestus counselor Charles Beckendorf.
description: Opening battle of Book 5 where Percy and Beckendorf plant Greek fire explosives aboard Kronos's flagship.

name: Percy's Bath in the River Styx
outcome: Percy successfully bathes in the River Styx while anchoring his soul to Sally Jackson, acquiring invulnerability across his body except for a small spot on his lower back.
significance: Gave Percy the Curse of Achilles required to withstand Kronos's titan form in combat.
description: Dangerous ritual in the Underworld where Percy Jackson bathes in the River Styx to gain invulnerability.

name: Battle of Williamsburg Bridge
outcome: Percy slays Minotaur; Michael Yew snaps bridge cables to plunge Kronos's vanguard into the East River; Michael Yew lost in collapse.
significance: Halted Kronos's advance into Manhattan from Brooklyn; cost Apollo cabin leader Michael Yew.
description: Bridge defense battle where Percy Jackson and Apollo archers hold off Kronos's forces.

name: Defeat of the Lydian Drakon
outcome: Silena fatally wounded by drakon spit; Clarisse arrives, slays drakon with electric spear Maimer, and reveals Silena's heroic redemption.
significance: Slew Kronos's ultimate monster weapon; revealed Silena Beauregard as the spy who redeemed herself by leading Ares cabin into battle.
description: High-stakes fight in Central Park against the giant Lydian Drakon.

name: Battle of Manhattan
outcome: Olympian victory; Luke Castellan regains control of his body and sacrifices himself with Annabeth's cursed dagger to destroy Kronos.
significance: Concluded the Second Titan War, leading to the Minor Gods Reform Decree.
description: The major battle across Manhattan where Camp Half-Blood demigods held the Empire State Building against Kronos's army.

name: The Olympian Council Reform Decree
outcome: Percy rejects personal godhood and demands that the gods claim all demigod children by age 13, build cabins for minor gods and Hades at Camp, and pardon peaceful entities.
significance: Fundamentally reformed Olympian divine governance and established Cabins 13–20 at Camp Half-Blood.
description: Post-war assembly on Mount Olympus where Percy Jackson demands divine reform instead of godhood.

name: Battle of Brooklyn Bridge
outcome: Clarisse overcomes Phobos's fear magic; Percy and Clarisse defeat Phobos and Deimos, recovering Ares's war chariot.
significance: Bonded Clarisse and Percy as allies; restored Ares's chariot before sunset.
description: Fight on the Brooklyn Bridge against Phobos and Deimos to recover Ares's stolen war chariot.

name: Battle of Times Square
outcome: Percy uses Grover's music distraction and wet mortar from a billboard site to trap the golden Celedon automaton.
significance: Recaptured Apollo's golden singer in time for his Mount Olympus concert.
description: Chaotic urban battle in Times Square against a runaway golden singing automaton.
